newsitem.title: UK: RMC up as report highlights broker comment.
newsitem.headline: RMC up as report highlights broker comment.

text.p: Shares in building materials group RMC Group Plc extended recent gains on Thursday as a report in the Financial Times highlighted a recommendation on the stock from brokerage Teather & Greenwood, dealers said.
The stock was quoted 24p or 2.6 percent higher at 959 by 0853 GMT in thin volume of just 155,554 shares.
Analyst David Taylor at Teather said his comments had followed a recent briefing with the company ahead of its half-year results due in mid September.

He said the stock was trading well below its year high and had been at a near-20 percent discount to the rest of the market in terms of its prospective price-earnings multiple for 1997, despite signs of an improving trading performance in key markets.
"The basic message coming through is that profits in Germany are likely to be up in mark terms," Taylor said, "they have a unique position in Berlin which is the biggest building site in Europe."
He said sterling profits would be depressed by translation effects because of the strong pound yet the company's actual trading in France for example was largely better than he had expected.
"The current share price bounce should continue and any signs of a German construction recovery will lead to a re-rating," Taylor said.
